title: Funky Head Boxers (Demo)
native_title: ファンキー・ヘッド・ボクサーズ
overview:
The second installment of the Yoshimoto Funky series! Yoshimoto remakes a Sega arcade game!!

Advanced action and comedy perfected by the Sega and Yoshimoto tag team
Super-class fun that goes beyond the arcade version
3D polygons show their true power with the Boyoyon System!?
The all-out power of young Yoshimoto comedians explodes

A lineup of goofballs that will make even the ring trip over. Look forward to a huge free-for-all!

Even if you become unable to play from laughing too hard, rest assured you can enjoy it again and again.

Funky Head Boxers is a slapstick polygon boxing game based on Sega's arcade title. Every fighter has a huge cube-shaped head that squashes and warps as the punches land, and the ring is filled with young comedians from the Yoshimoto talent agency.

Trade jabs, pull off special punches and go for the knockout, alone or against a second player.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1-2 players
- Special punches entered with direction and button commands

吉本ファンキーシリーズ第二弾！セガのアーケードゲームを吉本がリメイク！！

セガと吉本のタッグが極めた高度なアクション＆お笑い
アーケード版の上をゆく超ド級のおもしろさ
ボヨヨンシステムで3Dポリゴンの本領発揮！？
吉本若手芸人の捨て身のパワー炸裂

リングもコケる、へなちょこ顔合わせ。大混戦に乞うご期待！

笑いすぎによりプレイ不能となっても何度でも楽しめますからご安心下さい。
